title: Record It Properly

patient.name: Mr Ramesh Pillai
patient.presenting_complaint: Charted for dilation of the right eye before review — focus on correct documentation

history.hpc: Mr Ramesh says 'Doctor only want to dilate my right eye today.' Only the right eye is to be dilated. This station focuses on correct technique and documentation of the dilation.
history.pmhx: No narrow-angle history. No drug allergies (confirm).
history.allergies: No drug allergy recorded on file.
history.social_hx: Teacher; came with a family member.

examination_findings.anterior_segment: Right eye deep chamber, safe to dilate; left eye not to be dilated
examination_findings.fundus: Right fundus to be examined after dilation

investigations.task: Dilate only the correct (right) eye and document the eye, pre-dilation pupil size, drops and dosage, and the time accurately
investigations.key_points: Confirm the correct single eye; record pre-dilation pupil size in mm; instil the charted drop into the right eye only; note the dosage and time; do not dilate the left eye

diagnosis: Only the correct (right) eye is dilated and the dilation is documented properly: the eye dilated, the pre-dilation pupil size in mm, the drops and dosage, and the time are all recorded. Confirming the single correct eye prevents dilating the wrong eye. This is a procedural/documentation station.

immediate: Confirm identity and that only the RIGHT eye is to be dilated
Check for drug allergy and absence of a narrow-angle contraindication
Record the pre-dilation pupil size in mm for the right eye
Instil the charted dilating drop into the right eye only, using a no-touch technique
Do not instil into the left eye
Note the dosage and the time of instillation
Document the eye dilated, pupil size, drops, dosage and time
follow_up: Inform the doctor of the dilation time for the right-eye fundus exam
Re-check if the right pupil is not adequately dilated
patient_education: Explain only one eye is being dilated and why
Warn the right eye will be blurred and light-sensitive for a few hours
Advise not to drive until the dilation wears off
